verdict.rationale: Zoho documents a Zoho MCP service (mcp.zoho.com) that explicitly connects LLMs like GPT/Claude to Zoho Books' APIs and actions, with customer quotes confirming real use for invoicing, bookkeeping, and reconciliation via Claude. This is an official first-party MCP server, not just client-side integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP connection flow beyond vendor marketing quotes, and the hosted endpoint is sign-in-gated so behavior couldn't be directly probed.
